**Harbor 2.0.6** — the setup wizard applies nothing before its last step.

## Setup wizard

- The storage step only checks PostgreSQL, ClickHouse and OpenBao: the server keeps them as a draft
  (`data/backend/setup-draft.json`, 0600, deleted at the end of the wizard). Nothing is initialised or written yet.
- The button of the sign-in step ("Create the administrator and sign in", "Connect Keystone and sign in") checks
  everything first — the password, the Keystone key and its administrator, the storage — and only then applies it
  all: OpenBao is initialised, `bootstrap.json` is written, Harbor starts on the storage, the administrator is created
  or Keystone connected.
- The sign-in step goes back to the storage at any time, also after a reload of the page: the draft comes back from
  the server, its passwords stay there (left empty, they are kept).
- The root token and the recovery key of OpenBao are shown after that button, as the last step, since only then is
  OpenBao initialised. If a later part fails, they are kept for the retry and shown when it succeeds.
- If Harbor cannot start on the storage, nothing stays half applied: the storage can be corrected and the step
  repeated.
